postal_system.assignment_rule: A pinned Österreichische Post postcode or destination-location record establishes a four-digit assignment at its capture time. UPU syntax, the first digit, a statistical region, or structurally valid digits do not establish current allocation or deliverability.
postal_system.perimeter_rule: A postcode, destination location, delivery route, post office, administrative boundary, or address-point cluster is not automatically an official postal-operator polygon. Statistik Austria postcode regions remain official statistical geometry; an address-membership surface is explicitly derived and uncertainty-bearing.
postal_system.address_rule: Exact address display requires a pinned permitted BEV Address Register assertion or separately licensed Österreichische Post Address Data/PAC assertion with authoritative identity, status, hierarchy, coordinate semantics, capture time, and dataset-specific rights. Interactive search does not establish bulk retention or redistribution rights.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires the same BEV seven-digit Adresscode plus three-digit Subcode or a reviewed explicit authoritative crosswalk. Address coordinates, building coordinates, parcels, footprints, containment, and proximity remain distinct evidence and proximity is candidate-only.
postal_system.service_status_rule: Current Austrian Post validation or delivery-service state is a time-stamped operational assertion separate from postcode assignment, statistical geometry, address identity, and historical validity.
postal_system.cross_border_rule: A German, Swiss, Liechtenstein, or other foreign routing arrangement, syntax match, border clip, or provider record never changes Austrian country identity. Every AT feature requires independently pinned Austrian assignment and sovereign-boundary evidence.
postal_system.administrative_rule: BEV administrative boundaries and Statistik Austria regional divisions provide hierarchy, clipping, and statistical context only; they do not create postal membership or delivery eligibility.

temporal_model.valid_time: Postal assignment, postcode-region, address, building, administrative, and operational validity when supplied by each source.
temporal_model.known_time: Publication, capture, ingest, correction, service check, license review, and release timestamps retained independently.
temporal_model.history_rule: Current and historical Austrian Post evidence and later BEV or statistical snapshots append versioned assertions; no refresh silently rewrites an earlier release or converts a statistical/derived perimeter into an operator perimeter.

quality_gates.pass: Each full code references a pinned Austrian Post record with four-digit text, assignment class, destination location when present, capture time, rights, and digest.
Every surface declares operator-official, official-statistical, or derived authority; derived surfaces retain method, address membership, exclusions, uncertainty, validity, rights, and digest.
Each exact address retains provider, authoritative identifier such as BEV Adresscode, status, hierarchy, coordinate type, permitted fields, capture time, terms, and postal cross-check.

An exact building has the same BEV Adresscode plus Subcode or a reviewed explicit crosswalk; address point, building point, parcel, footprint, containment, and proximity are never silently substituted.
Every BEV, Post, Statistik Austria, GWR, INSPIRE, or search artifact pins its own product, release, access basis, license or contract, attribution, coverage, schema, CRS, update time, and digest.
No addressee, household, PAC customer profile, resident, owner, occupant, dwelling microdata, protected GWR record, phone, delivery instruction, credential, or private contract field is published.
AT identity and boundary are independently established; routing, postcode syntax, provider coverage, border proximity, or clipping cannot import DE, CH, or LI identity.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, dataset-specific rights, address/building identifiers, geometry semantics, temporal coverage, cross-border rules, and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

Current rights-cleared complete four-digit assignments plus an exact operator or official-statistical Polygon/MultiPolygon, or a clearly derived surface from complete permitted address members, must pass immutable-artifact and real AT loader/API/app visualization gates; destination, district, municipality, address, building, special-code, learned and AGID geometry never become official postal areas.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, license, freshness, cross-border, and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
